articles.title: PSG’s Senny Mayulu out for several weeks
articles.summary: Paris Saint-Germain has confirmed that 20-year-old Senny Mayulu will be sidelined for several weeks due to an injury. The promising player sustained the injury while representing France on U21 national team duty earlier this week, forcing him off the field. This incident presents a setback for both Mayulu's immediate playing career and his club's team availability, impacting upcoming fixtures.
